about: Craft-matching cases built by app.scripts.build_craft_cases from the craft master list and craft_aliases.json (decision 0126). A RESOLVED case passes when its craft is the first candidate; an AMBIGUOUS case passes when the resolver says AMBIGUOUS and offers every expected craft.
